summary: Lithium Argentina AG filed a Form 6-K furnishing its 2026 Cauchari-Olaroz S-K 1300 Technical Report, effective September 15, 2026, along with consents from six qualified persons. This is a routine technical report disclosure for the Argentine brine project, equivalent to a US mining technical summary exhibit, and carries no transaction terms, board recommendation, or financial consideration. The report details mineral resources and reserves, mining and processing methods, capital and operating costs, and an economic analysis, including RIGI economics. No special-situation event is present; watch for any subsequent operational or strategic announcements.
